tools.name: scan_website
tools.description: Scan a public website and report how ready it is for AI search and AI agents, using the AgentReady standard. Returns a level from 0 to 5, the count of checks passed, Found-by-AI and Usable-by-AI scores, every check with its status and summary, and a link to the full report. Does not change the websi

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "scan_website" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
